s1.title: Who we are
s1.body: TezDukan is a platform in Hyderabad, Sindh that connects dukans with distributors and customers. By using the app you agree to these terms.

s2.title: Your account
s2.body: Use your own mobile number and keep your password private. You are responsible for orders placed from your account and by staff you add.

s3.title: Orders and prices
s3.body: Each distributor sets its own prices, stock and schemes. An order is confirmed when the distributor accepts it. Large orders may be confirmed by phone before dispatch.

s4.title: Payments and khata
s4.body: Pay cash on delivery or on khata (credit) when your distributor allows it. Dues and payments are recorded in your statement and cannot be deleted, only reversed.

s5.title: Fair use
s5.body: Do not misuse the app, post false information or try to access other people's data. We may suspend accounts that break these rules.

s1.title: What we collect
s1.body: Your name, mobile number, dukan or business details, location you choose to share, orders, payments and messages you send in the app.

s2.title: Why we use it
s2.body: To create your account, deliver orders, keep your khata, send order updates and notifications, give support and keep the service safe.

s3.title: Who can see it
s3.body: Distributors you order from see your dukan name, phone and address. We never sell your data. Service providers (hosting, SMS) process it only for us.

s4.title: Your choices
s4.body: You can turn phone notifications off, change your details, or ask us to delete your account and data through Help and support in the app.

s5.title: Security
s5.body: Your data is stored encrypted on secure servers, and each dukan and distributor can only see its own records.

s1.title: Damaged or short items
s1.body: Report damaged, expired or missing items from the order page within 48 hours of delivery, with a photo where possible.

s2.title: How refunds work
s2.body: Approved claims are credited to your khata with your distributor, or paid back the way you paid. The distributor decides each claim.

s3.title: Cancelled orders
s3.body: You can cancel an order before it is packed. If you already paid, the full amount is returned.
